zh: 这时已是四月底，王有龄要打点上任，忙得不可开交。胡雪岩当然更忙，既要为王有龄参赞，又要忙自己的钱庄。亏得刘庆生十分得力，在运司河下典了一幢极体面的房子，油漆粉恻，自己督工，此外做招牌、买家具、请伙计，里里外外，一手包办，每天起早落夜，累得人又黑又瘦，但人逢喜事精神爽，丝毫不以为苦。上任的黄道吉日挑定了，选定五月初九。这一下设宴饯行的帖子，纷纷飞到。做事容易做官难，应酬不能不到，王有龄时间不够，大感苦恼，等看到张胖子也来了一张请帖，就想躲懒了。“你看，”他对胡雪岩苦笑， “张胖子也来凑热闹！算了吧，托你替我去打个招呼，留着他那顿酒，等我上省再叩扰。”胡雪岩心想，张胖子的情分不同，利害关系，格外密切，王有龄实在不能不给他一个面子。不过排排他的帖子，一天总有两三处应酬，也实在为难。想了一下，他有了个主意：“本来我也要意思意思……”“自己弟兄，”王有龄抢着说道，“大可免了。”“雪公，你听我说完。”胡雪岩又说，“本着我想把我的‘档子’让给张胖了，张胖子人不错，应该要买买他的帐。现在既抽不出工夫，就这样办，让张胖子那桌酒摆在船上，雪公，你看好不好？““我，我还不大懂你的意思。”
en: By now it was the end of the fourth month. Wang was overwhelmed with preparations for taking office, and Hu was busier still, both advising him and establishing the bank. Fortunately, Liu was extremely capable. He had taken a handsome building in pledge at Yunsi Hexia and personally supervised its painting and plastering. Signboards, furniture, employees—he managed everything inside and out. Rising early and retiring late, he grew dark and thin with fatigue, but his delight in the opportunity made the work seem no hardship. An auspicious day had been chosen for Wang to take office: the ninth of the fifth month. Invitations to farewell dinners poured in. Doing business was easier than being an official; social obligations could not be neglected. Wang was distressed by the lack of time. When Zhang's invitation arrived, he hoped to evade it. “Look,” he said to Hu with a rueful smile, “Zhang has joined the crowd! Please explain for me. Let him keep his dinner until I return to the provincial capital.” Hu thought their relationship with Zhang too special, their interests too closely connected, for Wang to deny him this respect. Yet the invitations showed two or three engagements every day. After a moment he had an idea. “I had intended to offer a little hospitality myself...” “Between brothers, that can certainly be dispensed with,” Wang interrupted. “Let me finish. I'd thought of giving Zhang my place in the schedule. He's a good man, and we should accommodate him. Since there's no time, why not serve his banquet aboard the boat?” “I don't quite understand.”

zh: “我是说，我和张胖子随你一起上船，送你一程，在船上吃了张胖子的饯行酒，我们第二天再回来。”“这倒不错！雪岩，”王有龄笑道，“其实你也不要回来了，索性一路送到湖州，那又多好呢？”“雪公，请你体谅我，我等把阜康的事弄舒齐了，马上赶了来。来在你也还没有到任，湖州怎么个情形，两眼漆黑，我想帮忙也帮不上。再说，海运局这面也是要紧的。”“对了！”王有龄矍然问道，“你的部照什么时候可以拿下来？”“大概快了。”“得要催一催杨用之，赶快办妥。我已经跟麟藩台说过了，等你部照下来，立刻委你为海运局的押运委员。这样，你才好替我照料一切。”“这不好！”胡雪岩说，“名义上应该让周委员代理坐办。反正他凡事会跟我商量，误不了事。占了他的面子，暗中生出许多意见，反为不妙。”想想他的话不错，王有龄也同意了。不过他又说：“不管怎么样，此事总以早办妥为宜。”
en: “Zhang and I can accompany you for part of the journey. We'll have his farewell dinner aboard and return the next day.” “That's a good idea! In fact, Xueyan,” Wang smiled, “why return at all? Come all the way to Huzhou.” “Please understand my position. Once Fukang is in order, I'll come at once. You haven't taken office yet; we know nothing of the situation in Huzhou. Even if I wished to help, I couldn't begin. Besides, the bureau's affairs matter too.” “That reminds me!” Wang asked sharply, “When will your certificate arrive?” “Soon, I expect.” “Press Yang to finish it quickly. I've already spoken to Treasurer Lin. As soon as the certificate arrives, you'll be appointed a convoy commissioner at the bureau. Then you can manage everything for me.” “That isn't the best arrangement. Nominally, Zhou should act as executive director. He'll consult me on everything, so nothing will suffer. If I take his distinction, he'll develop private grievances and things may go badly.” Wang saw the reason and agreed. “In any case, the sooner the purchase is completed, the better.”

zh: “是的。也不尽是这一桩。等把你送上了任，我这里另外有个场面，搬个家，略略摆些排场，从头做起。”“这也好！”王有龄笑道：“到那时候，你是阜康钱庄的胡大老爷。”这话虽带着调侃的意味，其实是说中了胡雪岩的心意。他现在对外不大作活动，就是要等官捐到了，钱庄开张了，场面摆出来了，示人以簇新的面目，出现了不凡的声势，做起事来才有得心应手、左右逢源之乐。
en: “Yes. It concerns more than this one matter. Once you've taken up your post, I'll establish myself properly too: move house, make a little display, and begin afresh.” “Excellent!” Wang smiled. “Then you'll be His Honour Hu of Fukang Bank.” Though teasing, he had expressed Hu's intention exactly. Hu was limiting his public activities until he had the qualification, the bank was open, and the necessary appearance established. Then he could present a wholly new face and make a striking entrance, enabling him to act freely and find support on every side.

zh: * * *出了海运局到信和。张胖子正要出门，看见胡雪岩便即改变了原意，他有许多话要跟他谈，却不容易找得着他，难得见他自己上门，不肯轻易放过这个可以长谈的机会。“雪岩，你是越来越忙，越来越阔了，要寻你说两句话，比见什么大官儿都难。”“张先生！”胡雪岩听出他的口风不大对劲，赶紧辩白：“我是穷忙，哪里敢摆架子？有事你叫‘学生子’到我家里通知一声，我敢不来？”“言重，言重！”张胖子知道自己的话说得过分了些，也忙着自我转圜，“自己弟兄，说句把笑话，你不能当真。”“哪里会当真？不过，今天是无事不登三宝殿……”接着，他肥张胖子为王有龄饯行，希望改换一个方式的话一说，张胖子欣然表示同意。“雪岩，”他又说，“听说你捐了个州县班子？”“是的。”胡雪岩不等他再问，把这件事的来龙去脉，源源本本告诉了他。如果说张胖子对他还有些芥蒂，看他这样无话不谈的态度，心里也释然了，“雪岩”，他是真的觉得高兴，“将来你得发了。说起来是我们信和出身，我也有面子。”
en: Leaving the bureau, Hu went to Xinhe. Zhang had been about to go out, but changed his plans on seeing him. He had much to discuss and rarely managed to find Hu. Now that Hu had come of his own accord, he would not lightly surrender the opportunity for a long talk. “Xueyan, you're busier and richer every day. Getting a word with you is harder than seeing a great official.” Hu heard the wrong note and quickly explained. “Mr Zhang, I'm merely run off my feet. How could I put on airs with you? Send an apprentice to my house, and would I dare not come?” “You put it too strongly!” Zhang knew he had gone too far and hastened to repair the impression. “We're brothers. A joke or two shouldn't be taken seriously.” “Naturally not. But today I have come with a purpose...” Hu explained the proposed change to Wang's farewell dinner, and Zhang readily agreed. “I hear you've purchased a magistrate's qualification?” “Yes.” Before another question could follow, Hu gave the full history of the decision. If Zhang still felt any resentment, this openness dispelled it. “Xueyan,” he said with genuine pleasure, “you'll rise far. And since you began at Xinhe, I'll share the credit.”

zh: 胡雪岩笑笑不答，站起身说：“刚才看你要出门，我不耽搁你的工夫了，改天再谈。”“喔！”张胖子突然说道：“老张来过了！”“哪个老张？”“你看你！只记得他女儿，不记得她老子。”“噢……”胡雪岩笑了，“是阿珠的爹！”“对了，也不知道老张怎么打听到我这个地方？他说他刚从上海回来，听说王大老爷放了湖州府，上任要船，无论如何要挑挑他。我说我不清楚这事，要问你。我把你府上的地址告诉他了。”我也帮不得他的忙。人家新官上任，自有人替他办差。象这种小事情我也要插手，那不给人骂死？““我不管了。”张胖子笑道：“反正老张会去看你，只要你不怕阿珠‘骂死’，你尽管回他好了。”“要么这样。”胡雪岩灵机一动，“我们不是要送雪公一程，第二天回来不也要船吧？那就用老张的船。”“对，对！这样子在阿珠面上也可以交代。”
en: Hu smiled without answering, then rose. “You were about to go out. I won't detain you. We'll talk another day.” “Oh!” Zhang suddenly said. “Old Zhang came by.” “Which Old Zhang?” “Look at you! You remember his daughter but not her father.” “Ah...” Hu smiled. “A'zhu's father.” “Exactly. I don't know how he found me. He'd just returned from Shanghai and heard that His Honour was appointed to Huzhou. He insisted that his boat be chosen for the journey. I said I knew nothing of the arrangements and he must ask you. I gave him your address.” “I can't help him either. A new official has people arranging his journey. If I interfere even in trifles like that, everyone will curse me.” “That's no concern of mine.” Zhang laughed. “He'll come to see you. If you're not afraid of A'zhu cursing you, refuse him.” “How about this?” Hu had a sudden idea. “We're accompanying Mr Xuexuan for a stage and returning the following day. We'll need a boat too. We can use Old Zhang's.” “Exactly. That gives you a satisfactory answer for A'zhu.”

zh: 张胖子开口阿珠，闭口阿珠，倒勾起了胡雪岩的旧情。想想那轻颦浅笑，一会儿悲，一会儿喜的神态，着实有些回味。因而第二天上午特意不出门，在家里开阜康开张以后，预备要去兜揽的客户名单，借此等老张上门，好订他的船。谁知老张没有来，他老婆来了，新用的一个小丫头阿香来报，说有位“张太太”要见他。骤听之下，莫名其妙，随后才想到可能是阿珠的娘，从玻璃窗望出去，果然！张太太就张太太吧！胡雪岩心想，她也是好人家出身，再则看阿珠的分上，就抬抬她的身分，于是迎出来招呼一声：“张太太！”“不敢当，不敢当，胡老爷！”说着，她把手上提着的礼物，放在一旁，裣衽为礼，“老早想来给胡太太请安，一直穷忙。胡太太呢！”女眷应该情请后厅相会，但胡雪岩顾虑他妻子还不明究竟，先要向她说清楚，所以故意把话扯了开去，“在里头。”他指着礼物又说，“何必还要带东西来？太客气了！”“自己做的粗东西，不中吃，不过一点心意。”她一面说，一面把纸包和篾篓打了开来，顿时香味扑鼻，那是她的拿手菜，无锡肉骨头，再有就是薰青豆、方糕和粽子，那是湖州出名的小吃。“这倒要叨扰你，都是外面买不到的。你等等！”他很高兴地说，“我去叫内人出来。”胡雪岩到了后厅，把这位“张太太”的真正身分，向妻子说明白，当然不会提到阿珠，只说她也是书香人家的小姐，又说这天的来意是兜生意。但既然登门拜访，总是客人，要他妻子出去敷衍一下。
en: Zhang's constant references to A'zhu revived Hu's feelings. Remembering her slight frowns and smiles, her changes from sorrow to happiness, he found much to dwell upon. The following morning he deliberately remained at home, drawing up a list of prospective customers for Fukang while waiting for Old Zhang so he could hire the boat. But it was the wife who came. A newly engaged maid, A'xiang, announced that “Mrs Zhang” wished to see him. At first Hu was puzzled; then he thought of A'zhu's mother. Looking through the glass window, he confirmed it. Mrs Zhang, then! She too came from a good family, and for A'zhu's sake he might raise her standing a little. He went out and greeted her accordingly. “You are too kind, Mr Hu.” She put down her gifts and curtsied. “I've long wanted to pay my respects to Mrs Hu, but we've been so busy making a living. Where is she?” A female caller should ordinarily be received in the rear hall. But his wife did not know the circumstances, and he wanted to explain first. He therefore diverted the conversation. “Inside. Why bring presents? You are too generous.” “Only some plain things I've made, probably not fit to eat. A small token.” She opened the paper packages and woven basket, releasing a rich aroma. There were her celebrated Wuxi pork ribs, smoked green beans, square cakes, and zongzi—snacks for which Huzhou was famous. “These I must accept. One can't buy their like outside. Wait a moment; I'll call my wife.” In the rear hall he explained the visitor's true identity, naturally omitting A'zhu. He said only that she was a daughter of a scholarly family and had come to seek business. But since she had called, she was a guest, and his wife should receive her.

zh: 于是胡太太跟张太太见了礼。主人看客人觉得很对劲，客人看主人格外仔细，彼此紧蹬着，从头看到脚，让旁观的胡雪岩觉得很刺目。女眷总有女眷的一套家常，一谈就把他搁在一边了。胡雪岩没有多少工夫，只好硬打断她他的话，“张太太！”他说，“他来晚了一步，王大老爷到湖州一上的船早就雇好了。”听他们谈到正事，胡太太不必再陪客，站起身，说两句“宽坐”、“在这里吃便饭“之类的客套话，退了进去。“胡老爷，你好福气！胡太太贤惠，看来脾气也好。”阿珠的娘又钉着问：“胡太太脾气很好，是不是？”不谈正事谈这些不相干的话，胡雪岩不免诧异，“还好！”他点点头说，“张太太，你的船，短程去不去？”“怎么不去？到哪里？”“只到临平。”胡雪岩将何以有此一行的原因告诉了她。“那再好都没有了。请胡老爷跟张老板说一说，他也不必费事备席，就用我们船上的莱好了。”阿珠的娘说，“鱼翅海参，王大老爷一定也吃得腻了，看我想几个清淡别致的菜，包管贵客赞好，主人的开销也省。“替我们省倒不必，只要菜好就是了。”“是的。我有数。”
en: The women exchanged greetings. Mrs Hu found the visitor congenial; the visitor inspected her hostess with particular care. Their intent scrutiny from head to foot made Hu uncomfortable. Soon their household conversation left him aside. With little time to spare, he had to interrupt. “Mrs Zhang, you're a little late. His Honour's boat to Huzhou has already been hired.” Now that business was being discussed, Mrs Hu need no longer remain. She offered the customary invitations to stay comfortably and take a simple meal, then withdrew. “You're fortunate, Mr Hu. Your wife is virtuous and looks good-tempered.” A'zhu's mother pressed the point. “She has a very good temper, doesn't she?” Hu was surprised by this irrelevant concern. “Quite good.” He nodded. “Would your boat take a short journey?” “Of course. Where?” “Only to Linping.” He explained the reason. “Nothing could be better. Tell Mr Zhang he needn't trouble to prepare the banquet. Use our cooking. His Honour must be tired of shark's fin and sea cucumber. I'll devise a few light, unusual dishes. The guests will be pleased, and the hosts will spend less.” “Don't worry about saving us money. Just make the food good.” “Yes. I understand.”

zh: 正事已经谈妥，照道理阿珠的娘可以满意告辞，却是坐着不走，仿佛还有话不便开口似地。胡雪岩看出因头，却不知道她要说的什么话？于是便问：“可还有什么事？”问到她，自不能不说，未说之前，先往屏风后面仔细张望了一下，是唯恐有人听见的样子。这一来，胡雪岩就越发要倾身凝神了。“胡老爷！”她略略放低了声音说，“我们的船就停在万安桥，请过去坐坐！”这一说，胡雪岩恍然大悟，老张来也好，她来也好，不是要兜揽生意，只是为了阿珠要他去见面。去就去，正中心怀，不过现在还不能走，一则要防他妻子生疑心，再则一上午未曾出门，下午有许多事不料理不行。“好的！”他点点头，“我下半天来。”“下半天啥辰光？”“今朝事情多，总要太阳落山才有工夫。”“那么等胡老爷来吃晚饭。”她起身告辞，又低声叮嘱一句：“早点来！”
en: The business was settled, and she should have been able to leave contentedly. Yet she remained, apparently unable to bring up something else. Hu noticed but could not guess what she wanted. “Is there anything more?” Asked directly, she had to speak. First she carefully looked behind the screen, as though afraid of being overheard. Hu leaned forward with closer attention. “Our boat is at Wan'an Bridge, Mr Hu. Please come and visit.” Now he understood. Whether her husband came or she did, the purpose was not business: A'zhu wanted to see him. He was willing enough, but could not go immediately. He must avoid arousing his wife's suspicion; besides, having stayed home all morning, he had many affairs to attend to that afternoon. “Certainly. I'll come later today.” “At what time?” “There's much to do. Probably not until sunset.” “Then we'll wait for you to dine.” She rose to leave, adding quietly, “Come early.”

zh: 等她一走，胡雪岩坐在原处发楞。想不到阿珠如此一往情深，念念不忘，看来今天一去，又有许多牵惹。转念到此，忽生悔意，自己的前程刚刚跨开步子，正要加紧着力，哪来多余的工夫去应付这段情？悔也无益！已经答应人家，决不能失信。于是他又想，既然非去不可，就要搞得皆大欢喜。回到自己“书房”里，打开柜子，里面还存着些上海带回来，预备王有龄送官场中人的“洋货”。翻了翻，巧得很，有几样带了要送黄抚台小组的“闺阁清玩”，回到杭州才听说黄小姐感染时气，香消玉殒了，要送的东西没处送，留在胡雪岩这里，正好转赠阿珠。
en: After she had gone, Hu sat lost in thought. He had not expected A'zhu's attachment to be so persistent. Today's visit would evidently involve further complications. He suddenly regretted it. His career had only just begun to advance and needed all his effort. Where would he find spare time for this relationship? Regret was useless. He had promised and could not break his word. Since he must go, he ought to make everyone happy. In his “study” he opened a cupboard containing foreign goods brought from Shanghai as gifts for Wang's official acquaintances. By coincidence, he found several elegant articles intended for Governor Huang's daughter. On returning to Hangzhou, they had learned that she had died of an epidemic illness. The gifts, no longer needed, had remained with Hu. They could now be given to A'zhu.

zh: 于是他把那些玩意寻块布包袱好，吃过午饭带出去，先到海运局，后到阜康新址，只觉得油漆气味极浓，从外到里看了一遍，布置得井井有条。后进接待客户的那座厅，也收拾得富丽堂皇，很够气派，但是，看来看去，总觉得有些美中不足。“庆生！”他说，“好象少了样把什么东西？”“字画。”“对，对，对！字画，字画！”胡雪岩很郑重他说，“字画这样东西，最见身分，弄得不好，就显原形！你不要弄些‘西贝货，来，叫行家笑话。”“假货是不会的，不过名气小一点。”“名气小也不行，配不上‘阜康’这块招牌。你倒说说看，是哪些人的字画？”于是刘庆生把他所觅来的字画，说了给胡雪岩听。他亦不见得内行，但书家画师名气的大小是知道的，觉得其中只有一幅杭州本地人，在籍正奉旨办团练习的戴侍郎戴熙的山水，和王梦楼的四条字，配得上阜康的招牌。不过他也知道，要觅好字画，要钱或许还要面子，刘庆生不能把开钱庄当作开古玩铺，专门在这上面用工夫，所以他反用嘉慰的语气，连声说道：“好，好！也差不多了。我那里还有点路子，再去觅几样来。你事情太多，这个客厅的陈设我来帮你的忙。”刘庆生当然也懂得他的意思，不过他的话听来很入耳，所以并无不快之感，只说：“好的！客厅的陈设，我听胡先生的招呼就是了。”
en: He wrapped the articles in a cloth bundle and took them out after lunch, visiting the bureau first and Fukang's new premises afterwards. The smell of paint was strong. From front to back, everything was orderly. The rear reception hall had been made splendid enough to impress customers. Yet something still seemed lacking. “Qingsheng, aren't we missing something?” “Paintings and calligraphy.” “Exactly!” Hu was serious. “Those reveal one's standing more than anything. Get them wrong, and they expose you. Don't bring in fakes for connoisseurs to laugh at.” “They won't be false, but the names may be less celebrated.” “Lesser names won't do either. They don't match Fukang's signboard. Tell me whose work you've found.” Liu listed the pieces. Hu was no expert, but knew the relative reputations. He thought only a landscape by Vice Minister Dai Xi—a Hangzhou native now organising militia at home under imperial orders—and a set of four calligraphic panels by Wang Menglou worthy of Fukang. Yet fine works required money and perhaps influence. Liu could not devote himself to the task as though opening an antiques shop rather than a bank. Hu therefore changed to a reassuring, appreciative tone. “Good. We're nearly there. I have some other connections and will find a few more things. You have too much to do. I'll help with the reception room.” Liu understood, but the pleasant wording prevented resentment. “Very well. I'll follow your instructions on the furnishings.”

zh: 话谈得差不多了，看看时候也差不多了，胡雪岩离了阜康，径到万安桥来赴约。这座桥在东城，与运河起点，北新关的拱宸桥一样，高大无比，是城内第一个水路码头。胡雪岩进桥弄下了轿，只见人烟稠密，桅杆如林，一眼望去，不知哪条是张家的船？踌躇了一会，缓步踏上石级，预备登高到桥顶去了望。刚走到一半，听见有人在后面高声喊道：“胡老爷，胡老爷！”回身一看，是老张气喘吁吁赶了上来。“你的船呢？”胡雪岩问。“船不在这里。”老张答道，“阿珠说这里太闹，叫伙计把船撑到城河里去了。叫我在码头上等胡老爷！”
en: The discussion and the day were both sufficiently advanced. Hu left Fukang and went directly to Wan'an Bridge. In the eastern city, it was as imposing as Gongchen Bridge at the canal's beginning near the Beixin customs station, and formed the city's principal water landing. Hu left his chair in the bridge lane. People crowded everywhere and masts rose like a forest. He could not tell which boat belonged to the Zhangs. After hesitating, he slowly climbed the stone steps, intending to look out from the top. Halfway up, someone called loudly behind him, “Mr Hu!” He turned to see Old Zhang hurrying up, breathless. “Where's your boat?” “Not here. A'zhu thought it too noisy and told the crew to move it into the city canal. She told me to wait for you at the landing.”
